title: x-adcp-validation
description: The vocabulary of the x-adcp-validation schema annotation, as docs/reference/schema-extensions.mdx documents it. A key is a core sub-key listed here, or an extension term {domain}:{key} on a domain its definer controls. verifier_constraints stays a free-form map for one-off rules. Validators of payloads ignore this annotation; scripts/lint-x-adcp-validation.cjs checks schema authors against it.

spec.description: Pointer to the normative section in the docs, a relative path with an anchor. Required when other sub-keys are present.

description.description: Prose that explains the rules beside it. It states no rule of its own.

trust_root.description: The field is load-bearing for signature verification.

schema_required_when.description: When the rule promotes from storyboard-enforced to schema-required.

verifier_constraints.description: Free-form map of verifier-side rules that don't fit a structured sub-key.

unique_items.description: Uniqueness by item properties, which JSON Schema's uniqueItems (whole-item equality) can't express. Each rule names the arrays it applies to and the key: no two items share the values of every key property.

^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?(?:\\.[a.description: An extension term: {domain}:{key}, where domain is a domain name with at least two labels that the term's definer controls. The definer says what the rule means; a reader that doesn't know the term skips it.

path.description: A dotted path to another field, from the annotated schema.

condition_group.description: Exactly one of any_of (OR-joined) or all_of (AND-joined), each an array of leaf conditions.

arrays.description: Dotted paths from the annotated schema to the arrays the rule covers. Omitted: the annotated schema is the array. With more than one path, no two items across all of them share the key.

key.description: The item properties whose values, taken together, identify an item.
